items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: He was a soft kind of player, but he could, he could play.

ctx.x: No. I had a fella named, um, I don't know if he called him, guy, his name was Robichaud. He was a soft kind of player, but he could, he could play.
Who did he play with? Jack Carey. Yeah. Why don't you tell me about him too? Yeah. Robichaud. Yeah, he was good, huh?
